content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NBPGR Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources (NBPGR), an premier organization under ICAR focusing on plant genetic resource management.

faq.question: Q2. What are the total vacancies available under NBPGR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available across various project-based posts including Senior Research Fellow, Young Professional, Project Associate, and Laboratory Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the selection process for NBPGR posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these project-based positions is conducted purely through a physical Walk-in-Interview mode at the designated campus address in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The scheduled date for the walk-in interview is 15 October 2026. Candidates must report to the venue on time with all necessary original and photocopied credentials.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The monthly salary varies depending on the post, ranging from Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 42,000 plus applicable HRA as per the guidelines of the funding agency or project.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualification is required for Senior Research Fellow (SRF)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Biotechnology, Agriculture, Botany, Genetics, plant science, Life sciences, or a related subject with NET qualifications and research experience.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at Room No. G-210, Division of Genomic Resources, ICAR-National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources, Pusa Campus, New Delhi, 110012.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been prescribed in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview for any of the advertised posts at NBPGR.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring relevant certificates, mark sheets, a filled application format, self-attested photocopies of all documents, original certificates, and a recent passport-size photograph.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of NBPGR?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources at www.nbpgr.org.in to access detailed recruitment updates and notices.
